summary: T1 item 8 (Characterization report), analog partition. SIMULATED aggregation of already-committed records; no simulation, extraction or Monte Carlo was run for it, and no spec bound or recorded verdict is changed. Indexed by spec/target-spec.md section, not by T1 item. Spec rows 1, 3 and 4 FAIL target and fallback; row 2 FAILS the five-corner target (8 of 9 (V,T) cells identified) and PASSES the slow/fast fallback; row 7 active and idle power FAIL target, fallback and stretch; the analog share of row 9 FAILS target and fallback (4.analog is unmet / no_evidence; 7.analog is met under decision 0006). No row passes its target, so this envelope is 'fail'. Rows recorded as NOT RECORDED, listed rather than omitted: row 8 (area) has no whole-block verdict in any committed record -- only the oscillator footprint share, 16 720 um2, which layout/README.md explicitly does not pass/fail -- and the row 1 second-library stretch, the row 2 continuous-skew stretch and the row 3/4 stretches have no record. The sensitivity matrix and its conditioning are shown before any estimate row (absolute kappa 27.8-67.9, ratio-only 19.8-67.9, rank 4/4, full matrix formed in 5 of 9 (V,T) cells). No estimate accuracy is quoted: the row 3/4 figures are graded failures against those rows' limits on the 3x3 (V,T) grid points only. Nothing here is measured.
